IAT cannot exceed maximum IAT by definition."},{"id":"R13","category":"definition","alternatives":["df['MIN_TTL'] <= df['MAX_TTL']"],"features":["MIN_TTL","MAX_TTL"],"rationale":"Minimum TTL cannot True)"],"features":["SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES","FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS","IN_BYTES"],"rationale":"Bytes/sec * duration (in seconds) should not exceed total bytes, since it is a rate derived from
